## Which Lab

Provide the lab name and number — e.g. "Lab 2.3 — Indirect Injection via RAG" or the file path `labs/module2/lab2_3_indirect_injection_rag.md`.

## Problem Type

<!-- Check the one that best fits: -->

- [ ] Step is unclear or ambiguous
- [ ] Expected output is wrong or missing
- [ ] Command fails / errors out
- [ ] Typo or formatting issue
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Description of the Issue

A clear description of what is wrong or confusing. Include the specific step number or section heading if applicable.

## Your Environment

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| OS | macOS 14 / Windows 11 |
| Python version | `python --version` |
| Ollama version | `ollama --version` |
| Model in use | qwen2.5:7b / phi3:mini / other |
| Shell | bash / Git Bash / zsh |

## Steps to Reproduce the Issue

1. Open lab: `labs/moduleX/labX_Y_name.md`
2. Follow steps up to step N...
3. Run: `python agent.py ...`
4. What happened:

## Suggested Fix (optional)

If you have a suggested correction or improvement, describe it here. Proposed text changes are especially welcome.
